remarks:
This house consists of 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, 1,224 sq. ft. with a 2 car garage and is located in North Tonawanda NY, Niagara County.

There are two entrances to the house, one in the front and one in the back. Inside, the house is well-built with some modern touches. There are 2 bedrooms downstairs along with a full bathroom. Upstairs there is another bedroom and another full bathroom. On the main floor is a large living and dining room combination that gives you plenty of space for the family to eat and hang out. The basement is partially finished and could be used for a workout area, office, game room, or whatever fits your needs. The washer and dryer are also located in the basement.

The backyard is fully fenced-in giving you a private area to enjoy or a good spot for animals to run. The landscaping has been well-kept and there is plenty of room to continue adding bushes, flowers, or even a small garden. A blacktop driveway leads to the 2 car garage which gives you plenty of room for storage. There is also a shed on the property for some extra storage.

The location is an added bonus of this property. It is located on a quiet dead end street near the Niagara Falls Blvd shopping area, within walking distance of several local attractions including boat and kayak launches, Mayor's Park, and restaurants such as Remington and District 37. The North Tonawanda Botanical Gardens are also just down the road, along with Deerwood Golf Course. A brand new bike path is located right across the street giving you another convenient way to get outside and enjoy the area.
